question: What does it actually teach?
answer: Real skills, for free. Workshops run by people who do the work for a living, and by Upskillers who learned it here last cycle, on the human side (framing problems, telling the story) and the AI side (prompting, building agents). The curriculum is modular and shifts as the tech does. Then you use it: on a Build Cycle, fast and on a team, or on your own project, at your own pace.
